name: player-eval
title_zh: NFL 球员本周上场值不值
tagline_zh: 赛前纠结要不要上 X？它把角色、对位、伤病、环境拆开算，直接告诉你现金局和 GPP 各自该不该赌。
tagline_en: Torn on starting X? It weighs role, matchup, injury, and environment, then gives separate cash and GPP calls—no.
desc_en: Evaluate whether a specific NFL player is worth playing this week and how risky he is — role, environment, matchup, injury risk, and cash vs GPP verdict. Use when the user asks "should I play X", "is X worth it", "how risky is X", or wants two players compared.
why_zh: 它不给你模糊的‘可以上’，而是把风险拆成现金局与 GPP 两套逻辑——同一球员在两种赛制下结论可能相反…
why_en: No wishy-washy 'he's playable.' It splits risk into cash and GPP frameworks—same player can get opposite calls—that's the.
limit_zh: 只认 NFL 常规赛周度决策，不含 DFS 薪资优化、赛季长期阵容、选秀或自由市场。数据依赖公开新闻与深度表。
limit_en: NFL weekly starts only—no salary optimization, dynasty, draft, or free agency. Uses public news/depth charts; no live injury alerts, confirm late.
title_en: NFL start/sit verdict with cash & GPP risk split
